message.subject: Collaboration with EDXSO on educational technology
message.email_body: Navigating the complexities of hardware choices for virtual reality setups stands out in your video on the Steam Frame review. Teachers and school leaders trying to evaluate technology for classrooms face similar hardware decisions. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership, and sustainable institutional growth, partnering with creators to develop useful content. We would like to propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. Would you be interested in exploring the idea together?
message.dm: Your video on the Steam Frame review caught our attention regarding hardware choices. Would you be interested in exploring the idea together?
